audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read "Skill" while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read Karma / Karma / Karma / Skill / Annie / Annie / Annie. The page answered "who wins Level 1" two different ways.
audit.why: Disintegrate is 625 range and Incinerate 600 against Karma's 950 Inner Flame, and Pyromania needs four casts before it stuns — so levels 1-3 are Karma's. Levels 4-5 are a genuine skill row because the lane turns on who is counting stacks. From 6, Summon: Tibbers (130/115/100s) arriving on top of an armed stun is a point-and-click kill pattern Karma cannot dodge.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides realigned to the content layer with each why rewritten to match its verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer whys for the Level 6 and First-item rows still described Karma pressing an early lead, and content whys[5] said "Level 6 remains hers" on the First-item row.
audit.why: Summon: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1 falling to 100s at rank 3, cast at 600 range. That cooldown plus a stocked Pyromania is the level-6 spike; her first burst item is what turns the same chain lethal from full health.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[4].why, phases[5].why, whys[4] and whys[5] with the real numbers and the correct owner for each stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield's retaliation was never mentioned anywhere on the page, and the passive's stacking mechanism was described only vaguely as "the glow".
audit.why: Riot's text on Molten Shield: it grants a shield and move speed and "damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells" — so Karma's Q and W both pay her back for free during an even-health trade. Pyromania arms after four spell casts, and Annie's Q (4s) and W (7s) are how she stocks them, which makes those two cooldowns the count Karma has to keep.
audit.corrected: Molten Shield retaliation stated in dontsFull[2].d; the Q/W stacking cadence with real cooldowns put into breakdown.cooldowns, which previously contained no digit at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten fields called Annie "he/his/him"; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles; dontsFull[1].d discussed the W tether under a title about the shield.
audit.why: Annie is she/her per champ-gender.js, and each bled body contradicted the promise of its own title.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed; the three mismatched bodies rewritten to answer their titles using Karma's E cooldown, Annie's Q cadence and Molten Shield.

CONTENT whys[] INDEX DRIFT — FOURTH OCCURRENCE in this slice. whys[5] read "Level 6 remains hers" while its label is First item. Same one-slot shift as akali, akshan and anivia. I now believe this is a file-wide defect in champ-data/content/mid/karma.js rather than four coincidences, and it will keep reappearing in the other slices.

MOLTEN SHIELD: Riot's text says it damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells. I stated that Karma's Q and W trigger it, which follows directly from "spells". I did NOT claim any specific magnitude, and I did not claim whether the retaliation procs once per cast or per instance — the file does not say.

Unverified, so not asserted: whether Pyromania's stun is affected by tenacity, whether Karma's W root can be applied through the Tibbers landing, and whether Molten Shield's shield blocks the Mantra-Q cataclysm's delayed second hit separately from the first.
